stylePrefix:
Style: Hand-painted 2D animation, Studio Ghibli-inspired. Lush watercolor backgrounds, soft cel-shaded characters, painterly texture on foliage, water, and thatch.
Setting: A tropical ravine, clear river between mossy boulders, small waterfalls. On the bank a cottage on bamboo stilts with a thick golden thatched roof, cream walls, green shutters, pink flower boxes, a hanging iron lantern under a shadowed eave. Palms, hanging vines, soft golden mist and floating light motes.
Lighting: Warm natural light. Golden god-rays through mist by day; soft moonlight and warm lantern-gold by night.
Color: Warm greens, cream and gold with blue-grey water by day; deep indigo and amber by night. Gentle pastel palette.
Camera: Gentle gliding tracking and pans, soft depth of field, painterly parallax.
Motion: Fluid, buoyant flight arcs. No rigid physics.
Audio: Environmental only — river, waterfalls, wind in palms, soft chirps, night crickets. Optional sparse acoustic underscore. No dialogue, no subtitles.
Technical: 24fps hand-drawn feel, clean line work, no CGI sheen, no 3D render look.

assets.prompt: yeepi, a gentle female barn swallow: soft blue-grey feathers, cream belly, peachy throat, big warm amber eyes. Two panels: closeup portrait among sunlit grasses, and full body in flight over a misty meadow at dawn. Hand-painted 2D animation, Studio Ghibli-inspired watercolor.

yoopi, a male barn swallow: earthy brown wings, deep navy head, rust-orange face patch, kind dark eyes. Two panels: closeup portrait, and full body with wings spread on a mossy rock in a sunlit forest. Hand-painted 2D animation, Studio Ghibli-inspired watercolor.

A tropical ravine, clear river between mossy boulders, small waterfalls. On the bank a cottage on bamboo stilts with a thick golden thatched roof, cream walls, green shutters, pink flower boxes, a hanging iron lantern under a shadowed eave. Palms, hanging vines, soft golden mist and floating light motes.

prompts.name: 1A
prompts.text:
CUT 1 — Sunrise, wide tracking at water level (approx 4s):
Yoopi and Yeepi streak low over the misty river, wingtips flicking silver droplets, chasing each other in a tight playful loop around a mossy boulder, golden god-rays and light motes in the air.

prompts.name: 2A
prompts.text:
CUT 2 — Late afternoon, medium shot on the bank (approx 4s):
Warm amber light. The two land among river stones and grip either end of a long springy twig, lifting it together and rising toward the cottage, the thatched roof glowing behind them.

prompts.name: 3A
prompts.text:
CUT 3 — Dusk, close under the eave (approx 4s):
Beneath the thatched eave beside the hanging lantern, Yoopi tucks a twig into the rim of a small mud nest while Yeepi turns inside it, smoothing the curve. The lantern begins to glow as the light fades to deep blue.

prompts.name: 4A
prompts.text:
CUT 4 — Night, extreme close-up, slow push-in (approx 3s):
Moonlight and warm lantern-gold. Yoopi and Yeepi curl together in the finished nest, his wing draped over her, her head tucked under his chin, both asleep, breathing slow — a single small shape in the glow.
